snippet.title: Valhalla | Official Gameplay Trailer #1
snippet.description:
Valhalla Gameplay Trailer – Open World, Turn-Based Combat, Play-to-Earn 

Explore the world of Valhalla, a multiplayer open-world RPG built on blockchain. Discover Floki Island, tame and train Veras, and battle in strategic turn-based combat. 

Compete in PvE and PvP, complete quests, and climb the leaderboards while earning rewards through gameplay and tournaments. Build your strength, upgrade your gear, and shape your journey in a world driven by strategy, ownership, and competition. 

Play now: http://valhalla.game
